changeSet.author: oe
changeSet.comment: An instrument reports several records under one test code (a main result, its log, analyte records and their Ct), told apart by the record's sub-identity, the analyte and complementary names in the vendor's HL7 sub-ID notation (HIV-1&Ct). Mapping rows are keyed by code and sub-identity; existing rows are main results, with an empty sub-identity. A test row may name a second target for the record's call when the record also carries a number.
